title: SDR daily scratchpad - outreach + follow-ups
content:
Morning plan (quick):
- Goal: 20 dials, 12 connects, 3 meetings booked today. Focus verticals: fintech + mid-market SaaS.
- Prioritize: warm leads (last contact < 10 days) then inbound MQLs.

Call list (order):
1) Priya Nandakumar - Head of Data @BlueFjord (warm) - Last contact: 2026-02-28 - Note: Interested in cost savings for embeddings; asked for latency numbers. Next step: Send benchmark deck + ask for 15 min demo. (Email template A)
2) Martin Osei - Platform Lead @ClearBridge - Cold outbound (linkedIn InMail) - Last contact: none - Quick script: 30s value prop (predictable latency, reserved capacity), ask for problem w/ current vendor. Next step: follow-up email w/ brief case study.
3) Rachel Kim - ML Eng Manager @EduLyft (inbound trial) - Last contact: 2026-03-01 - Note: trial usage spiked, concerned about cost. Next: propose Optimize call to review batching/quantization.
4) Alex Torres - CTO @GreenCart (referral) - Last contact: 2026-02-20 - Note: mentioned compliance requirements. Next: check Private deployment doc + loop solutions eng.
5) Samir Patel - Backend Lead @MarketWay - Left voicemail yesterday - Last contact: 2026-03-03 - Next: attempt 2nd call, then email w/ testimonial.

Follow-ups / emails to send (templates below):
- Email A (benchmark + ask for demo) -> to Priya N. (attach 1-pager + latency table)
- Email B (case study + quick ask) -> to Martin O.
- Email C (Optimize intro + calendar) -> to Rachel K.

Quick call notes snippets (log in HubSpot after calls):
- If they ask about private: note region + compliance (SOC2, HIPAA?). Flag to SE.
- If cost question: mention Optimize toolkit -> batching + cache -> typical 30-50% token cost reduction for chat-like workloads.
- If latency: reference hosted v. dedicated SLOs (50-200ms tokens typical depending on model).

To-dos (today):
- [ ] Send Priya benchmark deck (due EOD)
- [ ] Book Optimize intro w/ Rachel (aim for next Tue)
- [ ] Ping SE (Devon) about GreenCart compliance checklist
- [ ] Log all call outcomes in HubSpot + add tags (priority: high/med/low)
- [ ] Prep 2 quick case studies (fintech, ecommerce) for cold outreach

Reminders / personal notes:
- Keep dials short first 30 mins -> high energy block.
- Use calendar blocks 11:00-12:00 for follow-up emails (no calls)
- Ask for decision maker if speaking to technical contacts ("who signs off on vendor?")

Objections cheat sheet (short):
- "We already use X": Ask about pain (latency, cost, outages). Offer trial for side-by-side bench.
- "Too expensive": Walk through Optimize and Dedicated pricing tradeoffs; offer pilot credits.
- "Need security approvals": Mention Private + KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs.

Notes to self:
- Pull updated latency table from product-ops page before sending benchmarks.
- Add GreenCart to potential private pipeline and mark as enterprise motion.

Metrics tracker (quick):
- Dials today: 0
- Connects: 0
- Meetings booked: 0
- MQLs to touch: 7 (list above + 2 others)

End-of-day wrap:
- Quick retrospective: what scripts worked? Which objections repeated? Save top 3 lines for tomorrow.

Linked quick links:
- SDR playbook (Confluence) - https://confluence.redwood.ai/SDR-playbook
- HubSpot queue - HUBSPOT-23456
- Benchmark deck (draft) - /shared_drives/go-to-market/sales/resources/benchmark-deck-draft.pptx

Scratch / brainstorm (fragments):
- Short subject lines: "Quick question about model costs" / "Redwood: 30-50% token cost drop?"
- Cold open: "Hey {{first_name}}, saw you mentioned latency issues in your last thread — curious if you tracked per-request p95?"
- Follow-up cadence: 2 calls + 3 emails over 10 days, then break.

(End)
